title: Amendment No. 1, Memorandum of Understanding - Bay Area Community Resources - Learning Pod - Sankofa United Elementary School
official_text:
Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Memorandum of Understanding between the District and Bay Area Community Resources, San Rafael, CA, adding to the Scope of Work set forth in the August 26, 2020 Agreement (Legislative File No. 20-1178, Enactment No. 20-1206) the following paragraphs to the existing Scope of Work: 

Amended Scope of Work

VENDOR will provide in-person learning supports to students in K-5 at Sankofa United Elementary School. In-person learning supports may include (but are not limited to) support with accessing technology, facilitating access to classroom zoom sessions, motivating students to complete work, providing one-to-one mentoring or encouragement, and connecting with supplemental services if needed, and other supports as directed by OUSD.

As set forth in Paragraph 4 of this Amendment, VENDOR agrees to perform these services in accordance with any shelter-in-place (or similar) orders (“SIP orders”), and to immediately follow all OUSD directives regarding health and safety protocols. Specifically, VENDOR shall deliver services in cohorts with student: staff ratios that comply with SIP orders and OUSD directives. In addition, VENDOR shall ensure that all staff participate in wellness checks (including proof of negative COVID-19 test results) in accordance with OUSD policies and directives 

All other terms and condition of the Memorandum of Understanding remain in full force and effect.
funding_source: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant, 21st Century Community Learning Centers Grant
headline: Expands Bay Area Community Resources' scope to add in-person learning support at Sankofa United Elementary
summary: This changes an existing agreement with Bay Area Community Resources, a San Rafael organization, to add in-person learning support for K-5 students at Sankofa United Elementary School. Support can include help with technology and online classes, mentoring and connecting students to other services, following shelter-in-place orders and health rules. The text states no dollar amount, and all other terms stay the same.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment No. 1, Professional Services Agreement 2020-2021, No Cost - Soccer Without Borders - Community Partnerships - Community Schools and Student Services
official_text:
Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Professional Services Agreement 2020-2021 between the District and Soccer Without Borders, Oakland, CA, adding to the Scope of Work set forth in the December 9, 2020 Agreement (Legislative File No. 20-2149, Enactment No. 20-1742) the following paragraph: 

VENDOR will provide socially-distanced soccer instruction, wellness activities and team-building games as well as academic support to students in grades 9-12 at Oakland International High School and to students in grades 6-8 at Frick Middle School. As set forth in Paragraph 4 of this Amendment, VENDOR agrees to perform these services in accordance with any shelter-in-place (or similar) orders (“SIP orders”), and to immediately follow all OUSD directives regarding health and safety protocols. Specifically, VENDOR shall deliver services in cohorts with student: staff ratios that comply with SIP orders and OUSD directives. In addition, VENDOR shall ensure that all staff participate in wellness checks (including proof of negative COVID-19 test results) in accordance with OUSD policies and directives.

All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
headline: Adds in-person soccer, wellness and academic support at two schools to Soccer Without Borders deal
summary: This amendment adds to the scope of the December 9, 2020 agreement with Soccer Without Borders. The group will provide socially distanced soccer instruction, wellness activities and academic support for grades 9-12 at Oakland International High School and grades 6-8 at Frick Middle School, following shelter-in-place orders, district health rules and staff COVID-19 testing. There is no added cost.
schools: Oakland International High School; Frick Middle School
